items.question: What is the UAE corporate tax rate on taxable income above AED 375,000?
items.fact: UAE corporate tax rate is 9% above AED 375,000 taxable income

items.question: Which federal decree-law governs the taxation of corporations and businesses under UAE corporate tax?
items.gold: Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022 and its amendments
items.fact: UAE corporate tax is governed by Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022
